subject: pathology
title: Ovarian Tumours: Serous and Mucinous, Teratoma, Granulosa, Meigs, Krukenberg, and CA-125

steps.tx: Serous cystadenoma lines simple cysts with tubal type epithelium benignly in reproductive years, borderline variants proliferating without invasion, serous carcinoma splitting low grade KRAS paths from high grade TP53 disease. That tubal family is **serous ovarian tumours, cystadenoma to carcinoma**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Serous tumours mimic fallopian epithelium; high grade serous carcinoma is a TP53 disease of tubal origin often.

steps.tx: Psammoma bodies laminate concentric calcifications in serous tumours and papillary thyroid carcinoma alike, meningiomas joining, their presence suggesting rather than proving malignancy. Those calcified whorls are **psammoma bodies**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Psammoma bodies appear in serous, thyroid papillary, and meningioma pathology; context gives them meaning.

steps.tx: Mucinous ovarian tumours grow huge multilocular mucin cysts, primary disease distinguished from appendiceal and pancreatic metastases by size laterality and immunophenotype. That distinction prevents wrong therapy: **primary versus metastatic mucinous ovarian tumour**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Bilateral mucinous ovarian masses think appendix and pancreas first; huge unilateral thinks ovary.

vis.caption: Ovarian cyst types from functional cysts toward neoplastic differentials.

steps.tx: Pseudomyxoma peritonei returns as appendiceal mucinous neoplasm rupture filling abdomen, ovarian involvement usually secondary passenger rather than primary source in modern understanding. That source correction is **appendiceal origin of pseudomyxoma peritonei**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Pseudomyxoma usually starts in appendix, not ovary; remove the appendix story from every case.

steps.tx: Mature cystic teratoma, dermoid cyst, carries hair, sebum, teeth, and thyroid in Rokitansky nodules, torsion its emergency, malignant transformation rare in older patients. That germ layer potpourri is **mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst)**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Hair, teeth, and sebum in an ovarian cyst mean dermoid; torsion is its emergency, cancer its rarity.

steps.tx: Granulosa cell tumours secrete oestrogen causing precocity or postmenopausal bleeding, Call-Exner bodies rosetting around eosinophilic material, inhibin marking and late recurrences haunting follow up. Those rosettes are **Call-Exner bodies of granulosa cell tumour**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely.
steps.say: Oestrogen symptoms plus Call-Exner bodies name granulosa cell tumour; its recurrences arrive decades late.

vis.caption: Granulosa cell tumour with Call-Exner bodies and oestrogenic effects.

steps.tx: Meigs syndrome triads ovarian fibroma, pleural effusion, and ascites resolving after tumour removal, mimicking disseminated malignancy while benign. That vanishing fluid is **Meigs syndrome of ovarian fibroma**. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Fibroma plus effusion plus ascites that vanish after excision spell Meigs syndrome, malignancy's innocent mimic.

vis.caption: Ovarian tumour marker map across surface, germ cell, and sex cord families.

steps.tx: CA-125 monitors epithelial ovarian cancer burden and recurrence imperfectly, Krukenberg signet metastases reminding that ovarian masses may be gastric messengers requiring primary hunt. That dual lesson is **CA-125 limits and Krukenberg primary hunt in ovarian masses**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: CA-125 trends treat, never diagnose alone; bilateral signet masses send endoscopes to the stomach.
